verdict.rationale: Figma's own docs describe simultaneous multiplayer editing: teams 'work together in multiplayer files' with 'cursor chat in one shared space,' and design 'together in real-time and in one place.' That covers the core of shared simultaneous editing. However, live cursors are only implied through the cursor-chat feature, and instant sync is supported only by a marketing-level 'real-time' claim. missing for 10: explicit documentation of live cursor presence, technical detail on sync latency or conflict handling, and independent or hands-on corroboration of real-time multiplayer behavior.

support.subject: As a designer, my whole team can edit the same file simultaneously with live cursors and instant sync

citations.quote: Work together in multiplayer files, share feedback with comments, and talk to your teammates with cursor chat in one shared space.
Figma allows designers to create and prototype their digital experiences - together in real-time and in one place
Anyone can edit designs and riff with the agent to refine.
